scope: Discussion runtime, admission, transactional stage barriers, resource ledger, retry and recovery, worker and outbox dispatch, command and resumption boundaries

findings.title: Optional retry waiting can consume the protected synthesis and audit time
findings.trigger: A proposal fails with a valid long Retry-After while the other two independent proposals succeed.
findings.actual: plan_recovery checks only wait + 30 seconds. A 500-second wait is accepted within the default 600-second allowance although 190 seconds are reserved for synthesis/audit. The proposal barrier remains open. At the accepted retry time the failed proposal is skipped and synthesis immediately fails finish_time_reserve before making any model call.
findings.impact: A run with sufficient useful proposals loses both mandatory final stages because optional backoff was allowed to spend protected finishing time. No recommendation is published.
findings.recommendation: Compute retry eligibility from the same mandatory-stage time reserve used by authorization and request construction. If wait plus the proposed request envelope plus persistence and still-required final work cannot fit, settle the optional proposal immediately and advance with the other two. Add a deadline-triggered barrier cutoff so previously scheduled backoff cannot consume the reserve.

findings.title: At-least-once duplicate execution bypasses Retry-After
findings.trigger: A worker saves a retryable failure and its future outbox intention; an older duplicate message for the same Step is delivered before that intention is due.
findings.actual: Retry eligibility is represented only by Outbox.due_at. execute_step sees status=pending and immediately authorizes another call. The probe's requested wait was 120 seconds; the second provider invocation occurred about 0.012 seconds later and consumed the last allowed call.
findings.impact: Provider Retry-After is not an execution invariant. Expected duplicate delivery can exhaust retries during a rate-limit period, reduce discussion completeness, and amplify provider pressure.
findings.recommendation: Persist a step/attempt not-before timestamp or retry generation, enforce it under the step lock before authorization, and carry the generation in delivery identifiers. Keep at-least-once delivery harmless across retry state transitions.

findings.title: Clarification and manual retry bypass queue quotas
findings.trigger: An owner already has the allowed three queued runs and confirms an awaiting-input run (or requests an eligible retry).
findings.actual: Only initial Start counts queued work. The resumption endpoints set queued and issue a ticket without checking owner/global queue counts. The direct clarification probe increased the owner's queue from three to four with a configured limit of three.
findings.impact: The documented owner/global admission backlog bounds are not maintained across all enqueue transitions, weakening fairness and overload protection. This does not bypass single-executing-run or monetary limits.
findings.recommendation: Apply one owner/global queue-capacity guard under the existing policy lock to every transition into queued, including clarification and retry; leave the resumable state intact when capacity is unavailable.

inventory.algorithm: Command UUID idempotency and abandonment tombstones
inventory.assessment: Owner lock serializes original/replay/abandon; HMAC binds kind/body; gone and abandoned resources are not re-executed.
inventory.main_invariant: Owner lock serializes original/replay/abandon; HMAC binds kind/body; gone and abandoned resources are not re-executed.

inventory.assessment: Frozen model/request contract/configuration, revision/hash, attachment scope, one-use preflight, queue quota and explicit parent replacement are checked. Quotas are incomplete on resumption paths (RUNTIME-03).
inventory.main_invariant: Frozen model/request contract/configuration, revision/hash, attachment scope, one-use preflight, queue quota and explicit parent replacement are checked

inventory.assessment: Explicit accepted parent version/status, common transaction with child creation, execution-fence increment; reservations remain accounted.
inventory.main_invariant: Explicit accepted parent version/status, common transaction with child creation, execution-fence increment; reservations remain accounted.

inventory.assessment: Expected versions and command UUIDs preserve single intent. Cancellation fences future authorization, manual retry preserves counters/generation, clarification has immutable scope. RUNTIME-03 applies.
inventory.main_invariant: Expected versions and command UUIDs preserve single intent

inventory.assessment: Global policy lock, one running run, initial/resumption expiration, fresh ticket ordering, frozen configuration and deleted/terminal checks. Linear queue scan is reasonable only for the intended bounded pilot queue.
inventory.main_invariant: Global policy lock, one running run, initial/resumption expiration, fresh ticket ordering, frozen configuration and deleted/terminal checks

inventory.assessment: Maximum three global and two/provider; bounded execution leases are separated from indefinitely retained uncertain monetary exposure; image operations share capacity.
inventory.main_invariant: Maximum three global and two/provider; bounded execution leases are separated from indefinitely retained uncertain monetary exposure; image operations share capacity.

inventory.algorithm: Input evidence preparation and explicit hard constraints
inventory.assessment: Canonical hashes, exact recipient/owner/meeting scope, 24 passages, 2000 characters per passage, server-derived budget/deadline constraints. Preparation runs after intake, so newly attached passages are absent from intake (root cross-review).
inventory.main_invariant: Canonical hashes, exact recipient/owner/meeting scope, 24 passages, 2000 characters per passage, server-derived budget/deadline constraints

inventory.assessment: Three fixed provider slots and iteration-keyed steps; durable enqueue intent; synthesis needs two successful independent providers, audit provider must differ from the actual successful synthesizer.
inventory.main_invariant: Three fixed provider slots and iteration-keyed steps; durable enqueue intent; synthesis needs two successful independent providers, audit provider must differ from the actual successful synthesizer.

inventory.algorithm: Transactional stage barriers and state machine
inventory.assessment: All scheduled steps settle before advancing; closed barriers keyed by stage/generation/iteration prevent repeat transitions. Proposed brief is copied unchanged rather than model-normalized. Pending long retry can block mandatory work (RUNTIME-01).
inventory.main_invariant: All scheduled steps settle before advancing; closed barriers keyed by stage/generation/iteration prevent repeat transitions

inventory.assessment: At most one extra synthesis/audit pair; checks original request/money/active limits and aggregate logical-role counters. No convergence claim; after one correction publishes honest limitations if needed.
inventory.main_invariant: At most one extra synthesis/audit pair; checks original request/money/active limits and aggregate logical-role counters

inventory.assessment: Transactional report version, terminal state, active-clock freeze, unfinished step fence, retained eligible retry resources, unknown-exposure accounting, integrity fallback and mandatory-completion flag. Existing report makes duplicate ordinary finalization idempotent.
inventory.main_invariant: Transactional report version, terminal state, active-clock freeze, unfinished step fence, retained eligible retry resources, unknown-exposure accounting, integrity fallback and mandatory-completion flag

inventory.assessment: Proposals receive no peer outputs and imported-only claims; synthesis/audit receive selected committed outputs. Exact allowed-reference set and calculated timeout preserve finishing margin at dispatch. Error repair is regeneration with repair=true, no rejected output or validation details (root cross-review).
inventory.main_invariant: Proposals receive no peer outputs and imported-only claims; synthesis/audit receive selected committed outputs

inventory.algorithm: Worker claim, durable authorization and content fencing
inventory.assessment: Checks generation, iteration, expected stage, capacity, independent audit identity; commits authorization before I/O; reconciles usage even for fenced content; bounded persistence retry. Retry not-before is absent (RUNTIME-02).
inventory.main_invariant: Checks generation, iteration, expected stage, capacity, independent audit identity; commits authorization before I/O; reconciles usage even for fenced content; bounded persistence retry

inventory.assessment: 10-second heartbeat with 150-second lease, no extension without authority; ordinary requests max 90 seconds and task hard limit 120 seconds. These are engineering bounds rather than model-quality guarantees.
inventory.main_invariant: 10-second heartbeat with 150-second lease, no extension without authority; ordinary requests max 90 seconds and task hard limit 120 seconds

inventory.assessment: At most two calls/logical role and three infrastructure claims; refusal does not trigger fallback; auditor cannot fall back to synthesizer. Long waits ignore final-stage time reserve (RUNTIME-01), and fixed 2.5-second default has no documented jitter.
inventory.main_invariant: At most two calls/logical role and three infrastructure claims; refusal does not trigger fallback; auditor cannot fall back to synthesizer

inventory.algorithm: Manual retry eligibility and retained finishing funds
inventory.assessment: Only failed synthesis/audit in latest iteration, eligible failure codes, original active/request/logical limits and live funding expiry. No successful negative audit is treated as an execution retry.
inventory.main_invariant: Only failed synthesis/audit in latest iteration, eligible failure codes, original active/request/logical limits and live funding expiry

inventory.algorithm: Active clock and exact monetary ledger
inventory.assessment: Isolated high-precision Decimal arithmetic, clock regression closure, run/owner/deployment ceilings, unknown exposure across periods, protected finish money/calls/time, immutable authorization IDs, high-water unknown usage and explicit settlement. Every authorization scans ledger history; future scaling needs indexed aggregate accounting without losing conservative exposure.
inventory.main_invariant: Isolated high-precision Decimal arithmetic, clock regression closure, run/owner/deployment ceilings, unknown exposure across periods, protected finish money/calls/time, immutable authorization IDs, high-water unknown usage and explicit settlement

inventory.assessment: Provider/model/credential-version scope; three transient failures within 60 seconds open 30 seconds; bounded single half-open probe; counted authorizations and expired-probe recovery. Heuristic availability control, not accuracy weighting.
inventory.main_invariant: Provider/model/credential-version scope; three transient failures within 60 seconds open 30 seconds; bounded single half-open probe; counted authorizations and expired-probe recovery

inventory.assessment: Operator funding, immutable expiry/config hash/deployment epoch/request-contract hash checked on admission/authorization. Live validation was not exercised against an actual provider.
inventory.main_invariant: Operator funding, immutable expiry/config hash/deployment epoch/request-contract hash checked on admission/authorization

inventory.algorithm: Transactional outbox dispatch and delivery recovery
inventory.assessment: Outbox intent in same transaction; identifier-only at-least-once publish; publication failure keeps pending intention; advance dedup. Worker correctness must tolerate old duplicate deliveries (RUNTIME-02).
inventory.main_invariant: Outbox intent in same transaction; identifier-only at-least-once publish; publication failure keeps pending intention; advance dedup

inventory.algorithm: Lease expiry, orphan authorization and retained-hold reconciliation
inventory.assessment: Authorized abandoned attempts become unknown and are not blindly resent; unstarted claims retry at most three; terminal orphan exposure retained; expired eligible retry funds released; current-state barriers reconciled.
inventory.main_invariant: Authorized abandoned attempts become unknown and are not blindly resent; unstarted claims retry at most three; terminal orphan exposure retained; expired eligible retry funds released; current-state barriers reconciled.

inventory.algorithm: Event sequence, snapshot and reconnect replay
inventory.assessment: Run-locked monotonic event sequence and uniqueness; snapshot/read pages bounded to cutoff; SSE cursor clamping, bounded read batches and per-delivery owner/deletion/epoch checks. No DB transaction held over client stream.
inventory.main_invariant: Run-locked monotonic event sequence and uniqueness; snapshot/read pages bounded to cutoff; SSE cursor clamping, bounded read batches and per-delivery owner/deletion/epoch checks

inventory.assessment: Independent failure marker, dispatch lock, restore quarantine and deployment epoch stop authorization. Full backup/restore implementation is outside this focused discussion-algorithm lane.
inventory.main_invariant: Independent failure marker, dispatch lock, restore quarantine and deployment epoch stop authorization

limitations: SQLite deterministic offline probes; no fresh real PostgreSQL concurrency run in this lane
No paid providers, external requests, deployment or service disruptions
Passing existing tests do not prove semantic model accuracy or exhaustive absence of faults
